content.content: 1. License: no element of the dependent contradicts the prerequisite. Fail on any contradicting element — name the element. 2. The clause follows the sequence: the record step appends the entry only when it is not already a line, so IN-mechanism's order and S2-exclude-append's plain append are both untouched. Fail if the clause moves either — name it.
content.rationale: The record-once clause is where the bootstrap's ordered record step meets the append form and the caller's decision whether to write; the gate forces the clause to answer to the sequence without re-deciding the append or the order.
